children: Overview
Sweden investment and industrial holding firm's Q3 industrial sales rose 7% yr/yr
Industrial operations' adjusted operating profit up 30% with margin rising to 16.9%
Listed investment portfolio value fell 5.2% over nine months, lagging benchmark index
Outlook
Latour says order backlog stands at SEK 8,243 mln, supporting revenue growth in coming quarters
Company sees continued positive demand in most operations, but notes caution in parts of construction
Latour says macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty could affect future performance
Result Drivers
ORDER INTAKE AND BACKLOG - Co said increased order intake and a strengthened order backlog supported sales and future revenue growth
SALES VOLUME AND COST CONTROL - Co attributed improved profitability to higher sales volumes, efficiency measures, and good cost control
SECTORAL DEMAND VARIATION - Co noted robust activity in refurbishment, energy upgrades, and infrastructure, but weakness in residential construction in Europe weighed on some segments
